summary: [Google Analytics 4] capabilities: runReport, runPivotReport, batchRunReports/batchRunPivotReports, runRealtimeReport, runFunnelReport (v1alpha), getMetadata, checkCompatibility, createAudienceExports, runAccessReport. Admin API: property/account/data-stream/audience/conversion management. NO write path for analytics data itself: Data API is read-only. Sampling, privacy thresholding, high-cardinality '(other)' aggregation apply to large queries.
